title: Effective Lonza 4D Nucleofection with Inexpensive Homemade Buffers
author: Eric Danner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.64mhgu6

steps.title: Prepare AmaxaV Nucleofection Buffer
steps.instruction: Make working AmaxaV buffer from stock solution, vacuum‑filter through a 0.45 µm filter, store at 4 °C, and discard after 3 months or when white precipitate appears; stock can be kept at room temperature for >6 months.

steps.title: Count and Pellet K562 Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest log‑phase K562 cells, use 500 000 cells per reaction (1 × 10⁶ also works), collect the total number needed, and pellet at 300 rcf for 4 min.

steps.title: Prepare Plasmid DNA for Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Use 2 µg plasmid per reaction (Cas9 plasmid ≈9 kb); for fluorescent markers titrate 0.2–4 µg. Add plasmid to a well of a PCR strip in <5 µL (up to 10 µL acceptable, giving a final mix of 20 µL cells + 10 µL plasmid). Plasmids must be in TE or water.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in AmaxaV Buffer
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, add 20 µL AmaxaV per 500 000 cells (e.g., 3 × 10⁶ cells → 120 µL buffer) and resuspend; keep AmaxaV at room temperature.

steps.title: Combine Cells with Plasmid in PCR Tubes
steps.instruction: Add the 20 µL cell‑AmaxaV suspension to the side of each PCR tube containing the plasmid, tap the tube on the hood bench until cells fall to the bottom, then mix 2–4 times with a multichannel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the cell/DNA mixture into the 4D 16‑well strip.
Tap the strip to eliminate air bubbles.

steps.title: Electroporate Cells (FF-120 Program)
steps.instruction: Run the 4D Nucleofector using program FF‑120; perform this step quickly to minimize time in electroporation medium.

steps.title: Recover Cells in Culture Media
steps.instruction: Immediately add 70–80 µL IMDM with 10 % FBS and 1 % PenStrep (or Opti‑MEM for other cell types) to each well of the strip, yielding ~100 µL total; transfer the entire volume to a well of a 12‑well plate containing 1 mL IMDM/FBS/PenStrep. Add selection media after 16 h (next morning).

steps.title: Clean and Reuse 16‑Well Strip
steps.instruction: Rinse the strip thoroughly with DI water, place it in a 50 mL Falcon tube, fill the tube and strip with 70 % ethanol, let stand 5 min, then dry in the hood (or leave in ethanol and dry before next use). Strips can be reused ≥40 times.
